pieces.Text: A stone golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below. * A transmute rock to mud spell slows a stone golem (as the slow spell) for 2d6 rounds, with no saving throw, while transmute mud to rock heals all of its lost hit points. * A stone to flesh spell does not actually change the golem's structure but negates its damage reduction and immunity to magic for 1 full round.
